topic: Reviewing mall frequency data and frames
summary_markdown:
The session focused on the deployment of `mall-frequency` analytics to staging. Initial concerns were raised regarding potential inaccuracies in impression counting due to how frames were configured by others. It was decided that deploying to production was not necessary at this time, as further discussion was required.

Later, a review of sample data highlighted issues with frame orientation and placement (e.g., showing the wrong scene or repeating advertisements across all frames).
decisions: `mall-frequency` analytics will be deployed to staging environment.
Deployment to production is postponed pending further discussion.
